title: callerya pachyloba
intro: Callerya pachyloba, commonly known as Chinese foxglove or Chinese foxglove vine, is a plant species in the family Polygalaceae. It is a climbing woody plant native to China and Southeast Asia, valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Callerya pachyloba include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing fever and relieving respiratory issues.
